_comment: Golden corpus for the two command-line renderers: the runner's expressions.RenderArgv + engine.redactedInvocation (what actually runs and what the journal and cloud record show) and the portal's Emisar.Catalog.CommandPreview (what the operator approves against). The portal module is a hand port of the runner's rendering — argv templating, declared defaults, optional-element dropping, array expansion, scalar formatting, sensitive masking, shell quoting — in another language, and the two had only ever been tested separately. Both suites read this file; a rule that stops holding on either side fails there. `args` is a JSON object kept as a string so each side decodes it the way its dispatch path does (UseNumber / RawJSON) and exact number tokens survive.

cases.name: scalar substitution and a declared default
cases.why: the runner validates defaults in before templating, so an omitted arg with a default still fills its slot

cases.name: literal command with no placeholders
cases.why: a zero-arg action renders exactly its argv

cases.name: whole-expression array expands into tokens
cases.why: a list arg that is the entire element becomes one token per item, each quoted on its own

cases.name: integer and boolean formatting
cases.why: an integer renders as its literal and a boolean as true/false

cases.name: exact JSON number tokens
cases.why: the token the caller signed is what runs — never a re-spelled float, never a changed exponent

cases.name: spaces and metacharacters are single-quoted
cases.why: anything outside the bare-token allowlist is quoted so the recorded line is the shell-safe one

cases.name: non-ASCII is quoted
cases.why: the bare-token allowlist is ASCII by construction

cases.name: embedded single quote
cases.why: the POSIX close-escape-reopen spelling, on both sides

cases.name: empty string renders as a quoted empty token
cases.why: an empty non-optional value is still an argument

cases.name: inline optional absent drops the element
cases.why: -namespace={{ args.ns? }} omits the flag rather than passing -namespace=

cases.name: inline optional empty drops the element
cases.why: an empty optional value counts as absent

cases.name: inline optional present renders inline
cases.why: the flag comes back the moment the value is set

cases.name: whole-expression optional list expands or drops
cases.why: an optional whole-element list is dropped when empty and expanded when set

cases.name: whole-expression optional empty list drops
cases.why: [] is empty

cases.name: zero and false are not empty
cases.why: an optional marker drops only absent or empty values, never a falsy one

cases.name: hostile optional value stays inside its own token
cases.why: a value carrying shell metacharacters is quoted as one argument, whichever marker resolved it

cases.name: sensitive arg is masked and special characters still quoted
cases.why: mirrors the runner's TestRedactedCommand first case

cases.name: sensitive value embedded inside a larger token is masked
cases.why: mirrors the runner's TestRedactedCommand second case

cases.name: every element of a sensitive list is masked
cases.why: a list-typed sensitive arg expands into separate tokens and each one is a secret

cases.name: no sensitive value passes through bare
cases.why: mirrors the runner's TestRedactedCommand third case
